title: Chapter 465
paragraphs: Chapter 465
Episode 131. People with good instincts, people with bad instincts (9)
He barely twisted the sword.

If he hadn't changed its trajectory, the shining blue blade would have cut Amella and set her on fire in an instant. Although he felt relieved that he saved Amella, he worried whether Murakan could handle Upwha well.
"Ah, this is crazy!"
Indeed, Murakan was Jin's guardian dragon. Despite Jin only calling his name, he accurately understood what he wanted.
Hooong!
Murakan threw his body towards Amella and quickly transformed back to his true form.
["You got the snake eyes, and now suddenly you want me to take care of this too, huh?"]
Thud!
He swung his front leg, hitting Amella to the back where the Prochi siblings were. Her body bounced like a ball with the sound of bones breaking, but they regenerated in an instant.
If she had been touched by Upwha, she wouldn't have been able to recover.
The moment she fell between the Prochi siblings, she instinctively realized that she could survive.
I surrender, please stop.
The reason Amella spoke to Jin like this was none other than her intuition.
Fearful, she couldn't move her body recklessly or try to block it forcibly. Instead, she begged to be saved, feeling that Jin would somehow help her.
Her intuition was right on the mark.
["Kraaaaaaah!"]
And Murakan had no choice but to put all his strength into his abdomen and let out a wild yell.
It was because the spirit energy and blue flame were spreading like a tidal wave on Bradamante. Now, Murakan had to deal with Jin's Upwha instead of Amella.
The blue energy dyed the core of the murkiness and the space they were in all at once.
As if the insects touched by the light were hiding their bodies somewhere, the murky energy that had been coiling around quickly retreated.
It meant that the Upwha Murakan had to block was enormous.

Murakan's amber eyes were stained black with spirit energy. With the highest level of spirit energy release that Murakan could currently achieve, a curtain of energy darker than the blue Upwha was formed.
Upwha effortlessly tore through the curtain.
However, as soon as the curtain was torn, it was immediately spread out again, continuously blocking the approaching Upwha.
["Hey, stop it, please!"]
With each layer of the curtain being torn, the fire of Upwha was getting closer to Murakan.
He was on edge.
It had been quite a long time since Murakan thought of those five characters. No matter how great he was, his heyday was over, and if he took such a direct hit with his not fully recovered body...

Shuddering, he couldn't help but lower his head. At the very least, he would need to convalesce due to severe injuries; if he were unlucky, he might be tortured under the pretense of treatment by Misha. Just thinking about it made him tense up to the tips of his claws.

Maybe he would suffer only light or moderate injuries, and he could spend some happy and enjoyable time receiving bedside care from a strawberry pie? Was he worrying too much about the little brat's fire?
The moment he thought that, the intensified karma dyed his vision purple. He couldn't help but laugh bitterly.
There was no way. If he didn't do everything in his power to stop it, it could become an indelible stain on the history of the great Black Dragon Murakan.
(Black Dragon Murakan, severely injured by the sword unleashed by his own charge... Was he really the Sky Tyrant of a thousand years ago?)
(Kelliac Zipple's Fire Dragon Kadun's testimony, 'He's actually weak,' was it really true?)
(Jin Runcandel, as the contractor of Soldelet, punishing the negligent guardian dragon, truly re-establishing the hierarchy.)
(In one stroke, the 12th generation guardian dragon was defeated. Who is guarding whom? The numerous guardian dragons of the world, including Black Dragon Murakan, must be vigilant...)
For a moment, he imagined a future in which such absurd articles drenched the world.
He couldn't allow that stain to remain in his life, which had dominated as a tyrant for over three thousand years. He would rather die than live in such disgrace.
Now, the barrier of spirit energy could no longer block the karma. Flames poured through the torn barrier, and Murakan had no choice but to endure them while protecting his body with spirit energy.
He clenched his throat tightly in pain. As soon as the fireball touched his scales, a terrible pain stabbed and scratched his brain like a needle.
[Kroooooooot!]
He trembled violently as he tried to push back the fireball with his massive, dark body. His clenched teeth shook unstably, and it felt like cold sweat was pouring from beneath his scales.
His face, contorted with effort, became even more grotesque.
He was certain that if he took even one step back, it would be the end. He himself wouldn't die, but Amela would be reduced to ashes without a trace.
"Murakan...!"
Jin called out to Murakan once again with a worried heart.
[Don't talk! You're interrupting my concentration!]
"Ah, I'm sorry!"
Jin was also trying to return some of the energy used in the karma, as long as it didn't cause serious internal damage.

However, since the technique itself was so tremendous and executed with full power, it was no different from tilting an already poured cup. He could recover a few drops, but most of it had already escaped.
'Damn! This human, Amela or whatever, must be worth it... Wait, what am I saying?!'
Gurgle!
An uneasy, cracking sound seemed to rise from deep within his chest.
It was around his heart. And it wasn't the first time Murakan had heard such a sound.
'My, my heart...!'
He had heard a similar sound when his heart had been broken by Temar. The sensation of impending doom made his scales stand on end.
However, it was a strange thing.
If a crack had occurred in the heart, the power should have weakened rapidly, but instead, it felt like it was gushing out.
Like an inexhaustible spring, or like an oil well bursting in the middle of the desert!

The power that had been running dangerously while blocking the Raging Flames surged from the heart. The pleasure and fullness of the spirit spreading from the heart to the whole body tingled and made the back shiver.
'Could it be that the old power is... returning! The power of this body!'
What had broken near the heart was the work of his detestable sister, Misha.

When she had treated Murakan in the past, Misha had set up a kind of safety device in his heart. When the surgery was successful, it prevented him from using too much power with his once-injured heart.
At the time, Misha thought the safe zone was 40%. She had judged that if more than 40% of the old power was used, the recovering heart could be damaged again.
And just now, Murakan unlocked one of the safety devices heading to 50%, without even realizing it.
In the context of human wound recovery, it was like some of the stitches were removed.

Moreover, the reason the safety device was unlocked was not because Murakan forced himself to use power as he felt the crisis, but because his heart had actually recovered to the '50% safe zone' that Misha had predicted.
A 10% difference was by no means small. The wall between 10 stars and 9 stars was as high as the sky.
Kuh, haha, kuhahaha-!
Suddenly, Murakan burst into laughter like a roar.

The miasma that was already retreating from the Raging Flames was completely cleared, and the core where they stood regained the colors of the original Kaifa military road as cracks appeared like shattered glass.
In other words, the surroundings became open and the sky was revealed.
The huge figure of Bubar, who stood tall in the middle of the central island and intimidated the four major forces, began to become transparent as if it would soon disappear.
Initially, the giant Bubar had barely moved since the moment Amella faced Jin, but now it was about to disappear completely.
And with that laughter, which shook the entire island terribly.
The four major forces struggling outside could not help but be startled, feeling as if their hearts were sinking.
"This sound!"
"6th Gen, the guardian deity of the clan, it's Murakan's voice!"
"Could it be, the youngest...!"
The knights of Vugo and Run Kandel also widened their eyes in surprise.
"Black Dragon Murakan? Was Jin Run Kandel here too!"
"Captain, the royal magicians who are contractors have told us to avoid the Black Dragon at all costs during their mission!"
"Even during the recent Black King incident, the Fire Dragon of Zipfel and the Blue Dragons were said to have been scared and fled...!"
Biment's agents were also startled.
"Y-your Highness! I, I can't stand still because my diaphragm is cramping!"
"You idiots, aren't you awake? Your Highnesses! Our Bai Lang people need to worry about things like this... Ah, what are we supposed to do if even you, the kings, are trembling!"
"Y-you, you will also be, definitely, sh-shaking. If, if it comes close...! I, I heard it even smells like the Ming Wang tribe! We have to run!"
The beastmen of Kinzelo, especially the Redmane tribe, immediately showed signs of extreme panic and terror.

Unlike the Whitemane tribe, the Redmane tribe has good combat power but lacks a warrior-like feel. This is due to their racial traits, but the Redmane tribe also has a more sensitive intuition to fear and danger than the Whitemane tribe.
"Ha, the Black Dragon? Then… Jin… Runkandel is here..."
Lastly, Ziephl's Midor Elnar gritted his teeth with red eyes as he heard Murakan's laughter.
Jin Runkandel and Murakan were the mortal enemies of Mewron Ziephl, the brother he loved most in the world.
"Even the Fire Dragon Teo and the Blue Dragon Lalamakuaz turned back when they encountered Murakan. We must retreat, Seventh Tower Lord!"

"Judging by the disappearance of the giant figure, it is highly likely that the mercenary Amela has already been defeated by Murakan! Seventh Tower Lord, I know you want to avenge the previous Tower Lords, but now we must retreat!"
Whirr!
Midore raised a flame with his magic.
"Seventh Tower Lord!"
"Restrain yourself!"
The wizards of the Seventh Tower, both elders and ordinary, tried to dissuade Midore.
However, there was one woman who looked at Midore and laughed.
Even in his rage, Midore was attentive to her alone.
"...If Lady Sandra commands me to retreat, I shall do so."
"Kyahaha! Anyway, you're well-trained. You still pay attention to my gaze in this situation, huh? Impressive, really."
Her name was Sandra Ziephl, the daughter of Kelliac.
As Sandra was about to continue with a smile.
Kwarrarrarrar-!
Suddenly, the entire island was shaken by an even more powerful earthquake.
It was a phenomenon that occurred as Murakan pushed away the 'Upwha' he had blocked with his body.
And unintentionally, like releasing the safety device in his heart.
He soared into the sky, holding the Upwha.
Moreover, the Upwha turned darker as it mixed and fought with Murakan's spirit, and there were not many traces of blue flames.
[I am, Murakan!]
As Murakan threw the Upwha he held onto the ground, he shouted.
People couldn't help but mistake it for some kind of technique displayed by Murakan, not originally Jin's.
"Get away...!"
"Retreat behind the royals, no! Retreat behind the strongest warriors! Whitemanes, take care of the Redmanes!"
"Put up a barrier, a barrier! Quickly!"
"Damn it! Gather and form a barrier!"
The four major forces could only be horrified by the Upwha that Murakan unleashed.
